name: fly-app-template
description: Production-ready starter template for Fly.io Axum + SQLite web applications

scripts.setup:hooks:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('.git')){fs.mkdirSync('.git/hooks',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('.git/hooks/pre-push','#!/bin/sh
echo "⚡ [Pre-Push] Running affected tests..."
npm run test:affected
',{mode:0o755});console.log('✔ Pre-push hook installed!');}"
